description: One provider's full rating breakdown (composite, band, trend, six facets), with the two standalone readings beside it: agent_readiness {score, band} and front_door_ai (Front Door AI Index — 1-6 band, raw count, density, tier split, probe date; score is null when the provider does not own its front-door host). Null means no reading, not a zero. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

slug.description: Provider slug — lowercase, hyphenated, as find_providers returns it, e.g. "stripe".

name: get_provider_rating
